title.zh: 修订第82号《市镇法典》，授权省议会在任何原因导致未按该法规定举行选举时下令举行特别市镇选举的法案
title.en: AN ACT SO AMENDING ACT NUMBERED EIGHTY-TWO, KNOWN AS THE MUNICIPAL CODE, AS TO AUTHORIZE PROVINCIAL BOARDS TO ORDER SPECIAL MUNICIPAL ELECTIONS WHEN FOR ANY REASON ELECTIONS ARE NOT HELD AS BY SAID ACT PROVIDED.
title.orig: AN ACT SO AMENDING ACT NUMBERED EIGHTY-TWO, KNOWN AS THE MUNICIPAL CODE, AS TO AUTHORIZE PROVINCIAL BOARDS TO ORDER SPECIAL MUNICIPAL ELECTIONS WHEN FOR ANY REASON ELECTIONS ARE NOT HELD AS BY SAID ACT PROVIDED.
title.vi: Luật sửa đổi Đạo luật số 82, Bộ luật Đô thị, cho phép hội đồng tỉnh ra lệnh tổ chức bầu cử đô thị đặc biệt khi cuộc bầu cử theo luật không được tiến hành
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขกฎหมายฉบับที่82หรือ Municipal Code ให้อำนาจคณะกรรมการจังหวัดสั่งจัดการเลือกตั้งเทศบาลพิเศษเมื่อไม่ได้จัดการเลือกตั้งตามที่กฎหมายกำหนด
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 82, Kitab Undang-Undang Kotamadya, memberi wewenang kepada dewan provinsi memerintahkan pemilihan khusus kotamadya jika pemilihan yang diwajibkan tidak diselenggarakan
title.ms: Akta meminda Akta No. 82, Kanun Perbandaran, memberi kuasa kepada lembaga wilayah mengarahkan pilihan raya khas perbandaran apabila pilihan raya yang ditetapkan tidak diadakan

text.en:
Paragraph (b) of section thirteen of Act Numbered Eighty-two, known as the Municipal Code, is
hereby amended by adding at the end thereof the following: "If, for any reason, an election is not held as by
this Act provided, the provincial board may order a special election in such municipality."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same, is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect, on its passage, but shall be retroactive so far as necessary to authorize
the provincial board of any province to order a special election in any municipality in which, through error,
no election was held in December, nineteen hundred find four, as provided by the Municipal Code.
Enacted, January 23, 1905.
